name: U-Line®  Home Collection 15" 2.8 Cu. Ft. Panel Ready Beverage Center with Glass Door
shortDescription: The ideal addition to any entertaining space, the Home 15" Beverage Center effortlessly combines design and functionality. Expertly crafted for both indoor and outdoor spaces, this beverage center features a sleek black interior with stainless steel accents and a concealed, zero-clearance articulating door hinge. Choose from a stainless steel glass door or panel-ready glass or solid door that accepts your custom panel and hardware, or choose from the accessory door wrap options. With intuitive electronic touch controls, select your precise temperature from 34°F to 70°F, and set the mood with six-color multi-point LED lighting options, including bright white, warm white, cool white, light blue, deep blue, and teal. Showcasing a cantilever shelving system that allows for adjustability of a glass shelf, a metal wine rack and a 2-in-1 convertible shelf for glass or wine configurations, you can easily personalize your beverage storage to your needs. Enhance any gathering with a blend of precision and personalized design. *CUSTOM PANEL & HANDLE SOLD SEPARATELY*

features.text: Black interior with stainless steel accents
Classic bar door pull on stainless steel model
Concealed, zero-clearance articulating door hinge
Panel-ready integrated door, customizable with your panel and hardware, or choose from the accessory options
Built for both indoor & outdoor use, with condensation mitigation system
Carbon filter for enhanced air quality and odor reduction
Center cabinet vertical lighting: Complete illumination for full visibility throughout the entire interior
Door alarm activates when the door is left open
Effortless entry door: Minimizes the physical effort needed, enhancing ease of use for all family members
Electronic touch control enables precise temperature selection from 34°F to 70°F
Evenly distributed forced-air refrigeration system delivers rapid cool down and temperature stability
Field reversible door is shipped right-hand hinged
Four leveling legs adjustable up to 1"
Low-E coated, argon gas filled, double thermopane glass door provides protection from harmful UV light
Low-profile variable speed compressor ensures efficient and powerful cooling with a max output of 1,850 BTU/h
Sabbath mode disables interior lights, alarms, and digital displays while maintaining consistent cooling performance
Six-color multi-point LED lighting in adjustable white: bright white, warm white, cool white, and light blue, deep blue and teal
2.8 Cu. Ft. capacity stores up to 9 wine bottles or 54 12-oz cans
Cantilever adjustment points for complete interior adaptability
One 2-in-1 convertible shelf that allows for glass or wine configurations, one glass shelf and one metal wine rack
